items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I never did play with his, his band, but I played, he played on, on Lewisty Man's band, see? Well, he was with Lewisty Man.

ctx.x: Can you tell us some more about Frankie Dewson's band, or, or, who you played with then?

Well, Frankie Dewson, uh, uh, I never did play with his, his band, but I played, he played on, on Lewisty Man's band, see? Well, he was with Lewisty Man. Yeah, he was with Lewisty Man. Me and Lewisty Man and, uh, and Wilkin LaBeth. You remember Wilkin LaBeth? Yes.
I don't know. I heard of him.
